title: Braid groups and Burnside groups
summary: There exists an exceptional quotient of braid groups $\text{Br}_4 \twoheadrightarrow \text{Br}_3$ that is related to many interesting constructions in algebra, topology, and geometry. This quotient map also descends to a quotient of "truncated" braid groups $\text{Br}_4(d) \twoheadrightarrow \text{Br}_3(d)$, which have an added torsion relation on their half twist generators. In this article, we find a presentation for the kernel of this truncated quotient map that takes the form of what we deem a "primitive" Burnside group.
